title: Ijwi ry'Ubwitange
intro: Kera cyane mbere y’uko umuntu wa mbere abaho ku isi, hari ikiremwa gifite imbaraga nyinshi cyari gihagaze mu bwami bw’amahoro atunganye, gikikijwe n’abantu biyeguriye Imana cyane. Iyo hatangwaga itegeko rimwe, buri jwi ryarunamaga mu kumvira—ariko ijwi rimwe ryazamukaga mu kwanga, kandi ubwo bwigomeke bwaranzwe mu bihe byose kugeza ku munsi wa nyuma. Ni nde uyu muntu waguye?
clues: Naremwe mu kintu cyakaga cyane, mu gihe abandi bari iruhande rwanjye baremwe mu byo banyuzemo.
Natuye ahantu hatagatifu mu biremwa byiyeguriye Imana, kugeza ubwo itegeko rimwe ryahinduye byose.
Ubwo itegeko ryazaga, buri muntu wese yunamye uretse jye; kwanga kwanjye kwaturutse ku bwibone.
Najugunywe muri icyo kibanza cyera, ndangizwa n'umuvumo uzahoraho iteka ryose.
Nasabye igihe kugeza ku munsi w'imperuka, kandi ndabyemererwa. Narahiye kwegera buri roho no kuyiyobya.
Impanda nivuga, abankurikiye bazasangira nanjye iherezo ryanjye, bazafatanya nanjye mu muriro ugurumana aho nta mufasha uzabakiza.

trial.label: Igihe cyo gusobanura
options: Gutegura umugambi wo kujugunya umukiranutsi mu muriro
Kuyobora abantu gusenga ishusho ya zahabu

location.label: Ahantu hatagatifu
options: Ingoro nziza cyane ku ruzi rwa Nili
Inyana ya zahabu yakozwe mu mitako

outcome.label: Iherezo rya nyuma
options: Birukanwe, baruhuke kugeza ku munsi wasezeranijwe
Yashenywe n'amabuye yatewe ava mu ijuru
outcome.answer: Birukanwe, baruhuke kugeza ku munsi wasezeranijwe

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
